turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
Help Center here: https://help.wearfigs.com/hc/en-us/sections/360011981594-Shipping-Delivery Let me know if you have any other questions.

Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

Got it, happy to help! Yes, we ship to many countries worldwide. For most international orders, duties and taxes are included in the product price, and shipping is calculated at checkout. In the Philippines, duties, taxes, and shipping are all calculated separately at checkout.
